code_path_evidence.interpretation: The process reached the LeftBrain-call guard only after the 14-case capture comprehension completed. The guard is before the RightBrain loop and raw-result construction, so no RightBrain inference or scored result occurred. cognitive_tick can legitimately build a low-road plan with rules without calling LeftBrain.think.

control_failure.failed_assumption: Every captured final cognitive plan requires exactly one LeftBrain model call.
control_failure.actual_runtime_behavior: A final cognitive plan can come from LeftBrain.think on the high road or from _build_low_road_plan on the low road.
control_failure.why_the_gate_is_invalid: The gate measured an implementation route rather than the required experimental unit, which is one shared final plan per case.

supported_claim: The frozen pre-inference guard prevented a preregistration mismatch from becoming an invalid RightBrain result.
unsupported_claims: The current RightBrain became more natural or more human-like.
The current RightBrain should be replaced or deployed.

next_authorized_work.required_change: Require exactly one shared final cognitive plan and one attached human_speech_plan per fresh case. Record plan_source as model_high_road or rule_low_road, but do not require a model call for every case.
next_authorized_work.must_remain_fixed: RightBrain model, generation settings, payload comparison, independent gold, memory isolation, no retry, and automatic stop gates.
next_authorized_work.data_requirement: Use entirely fresh cases because V62 cases were consumed during formal plan capture.
